middle-ga-state.name: Middle Georgia State University
middle-ga-state.description: A public university with its Macon Campus along I-475. MGA offers a range of career-ready degree programs in business, IT, nursing, and aviation.
middle-ga-state.impact: Graduates hundreds of students annually with associate, bachelor's, and master's degrees, supplying local industries with skilled graduates in high-demand fields.

mercer.name: Mercer University
mercer.description: A private research university known for its comprehensive programs and professional schools, offering degrees in liberal arts, engineering, business, medicine, law, and more.
mercer.impact: Consistently ranked among top national universities; the School of Engineering provides a vital pipeline of skilled professionals in technical and STEM fields.

wesleyan.name: Wesleyan College
wesleyan.description: A private liberal arts college recognized as the first college in the world chartered to grant degrees to women.
wesleyan.impact: Provides undergraduate programs emphasizing career development and leadership, helping students find unique purpose through strong academics.

central-ga-tech.name: Central Georgia Technical College
central-ga-tech.description: A public technical college offering over 120 programs in trades, health sciences, business, and public safety.
central-ga-tech.impact: A key workforce trainer providing certificates and associate degrees aligned with local industry; operates adult education and apprenticeship partnerships.

hutchings.name: W.S. Hutchings College & Career Academy
hutchings.description: A dedicated career academy serving Bibb County high school students with vocational and technical pathways in healthcare, construction, and culinary arts.
hutchings.impact: Allows students to earn industry certifications or college credits while in high school through partnerships with local employers and CGTC.

bibb-schools.name: Bibb County School District
bibb-schools.description: Offers career pathway programs across all public high schools aligned with Georgia's CTAE curriculum, including engineering and IT.
bibb-schools.impact: Ensures graduates gain technical skills and work-based learning experiences to enhance employability immediately after graduation.

innovation-tech.name: Macon-Bibb County Innovation & Technology Academy
innovation-tech.description: A state-of-the-art extension of Hutchings Career Academy focused on emerging technology, robotics, cybersecurity, and electric vehicle technology.
innovation-tech.impact: Cultivates a tech-savvy workforce straight out of high school through a unique city-school partnership.

chamber.name: Greater Macon Chamber of Commerce
chamber.description: Convenes employers and educational institutions to align workforce initiatives with regional economic growth.
chamber.impact: Spearheaded the Workforce Asset Map and Greater Career Works; serves as a hub for employer input on talent needs.

mbcia.name: Macon-Bibb County Industrial Authority
mbcia.description: An economic development agency that recruits industries and facilitates job training incentives for expanding companies.
mbcia.impact: Connects companies with Georgia's Quick Start program and custom training at CGTC.

choose-macon.name: Choose Macon Initiative
choose-macon.description: A talent attraction platform showcasing Macon's quality of life and career opportunities to newcomers.
choose-macon.impact: Aids employers in recruiting skilled workers from outside the region and encourages local graduates to stay.

library.name: Middle Georgia Regional Library
library.description: Offers free access to technology, resume software, and job search workshops through the Business and Nonprofit Center (BANC).
library.impact: Lowers access barriers for residents to develop marketable skills in a supportive environment.

workforce-alliance.name: Greater Macon Workforce Alliance
workforce-alliance.description: A consortium of agencies focused on research, data analysis, and sustainable workforce solutions for the region.
workforce-alliance.impact: Instrumental in the research behind the Workforce Asset Map and regional collaboration.

newtown.name: NewTown Macon
newtown.description: Focused on downtown revitalization and small business incubators to attract and retain young professionals.
newtown.impact: Contributes to the broader environment in which workforce development thrives through quality of place and entrepreneurship support.

mgrc.name: Middle Georgia Regional Commission
mgrc.description: Provides staff support to the Workforce Development Board and manages regional WIOA funds.
mgrc.impact: Brings technical expertise and labor market research to regional workforce efforts and multi-county collaboration.

ga-dol.name: Georgia Department of Labor
ga-dol.description: A state-operated career center providing employment services and unemployment insurance assistance.
ga-dol.impact: Official resource for filing unemployment claims and accessing veteran and disability employment services.

goodwill.name: Goodwill Industries of Middle Georgia
goodwill.description: Operates a comprehensive career campus including Helms College, offering short-term courses in health, trades, and hospitality.
goodwill.impact: Provides free GED preparation, ESL classes, and job connection services to individuals with barriers to employment.

eckerd.name: Eckerd Connects, Paxen Youth Program
eckerd.description: Provides out-of-school youth (ages 16-24) with career guidance, GED support, and industry certifications.
eckerd.impact: Removes barriers via transportation and childcare assistance while placing youth into work experiences and internships.

ibew.name: IBEW Local 1316
ibew.description: Operates a registered 'earn-and-learn' apprenticeship combining full-time work with technical classroom instruction for electricians.
ibew.impact: Key pathway into high-demand skilled trades with no cost for training beyond nominal fees.

job-corps.name: Job Corps Admissions Office
job-corps.description: A free residential training program for low-income youth ages 16-24 in trades like construction and healthcare.
job-corps.impact: The Macon admissions office assists youth in enrolling in regional centers and helps graduates with local job placement.

arc-macon.name: The Arc Macon
arc-macon.description: Serves adults with developmental and intellectual disabilities through supported employment programs.
arc-macon.impact: Provides job coaching and works with local employers to create tailored opportunities in retail, food service, and custodial work.

greater-career-works.name: Greater Career Works
greater-career-works.description: A free web-based platform featuring 900+ 'career cards' with videos, salary data, and local training links.
greater-career-works.impact: Enables career exploration for students and job matching for adults and local employers in Central Georgia.

worksource.name: WorkSource Middle Georgia
worksource.description: The region's federally-funded Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) program hub.
worksource.impact: Offers tuition assistance for vocational training, on-the-job training opportunities, and career counseling.

gvra.name: Georgia Vocational Rehabilitation Agency
gvra.description: Helps individuals with disabilities access employment through counseling, job coaching, and assistive technology.
gvra.impact: Provides vocational evaluation and support for post-secondary education to help clients find meaningful work.

adult-ed.name: Adult Education Programs
adult-ed.description: Free adult basic education and GED prep through Central Georgia Technical College's Adult Education division.
adult-ed.impact: Enables adults to earn technical certifications and diplomas simultaneously to thrive in the modern workforce.

workforce-dev.name: Macon-Bibb County Office of Workforce Development
workforce-dev.description: A local government division focused on improving employability of residents through programs like the E3 Career Jumpstart.
workforce-dev.impact: Helps citizens, including ex-offenders and those in poverty, overcome barriers to gain education and trades training.

salvation-army.name: The Salvation Army of Macon
salvation-army.description: Provides free on-site job training classes to shelter residents through a partnership with Helms Career Education.
salvation-army.impact: Breaks the cycle of homelessness by addressing both spiritual needs and practical employment skills.

rescue-mission.name: Rescue Mission of Middle Georgia
rescue-mission.description: A faith-based recovery program for men and women that integrates work therapy and vocational skills.
rescue-mission.impact: Prepares clients for re-entry into the workforce through supervised work assignments and GED support.

other-faith.name: Other Faith/Community Programs
other-faith.description: Various local churches and nonprofits that incorporate workforce readiness, soft skills, and job fairs into their outreach.
other-faith.impact: Provides a holistic community support system including internship placements and emergency assistance referrals.

transitional-center.name: Macon Transitional Center Work Release Program
transitional-center.description: A residential facility that allows non-violent offenders to work paid community jobs during the final months of their sentence.
transitional-center.impact: Enables successful re-entry by allowing offenders to build work history and save money before release.

drc.name: Macon Day Reporting Center
drc.description: A court-referred intensive outpatient program for justice-involved individuals focused on reducing criminal behavior through education.
drc.impact: Increases employability and restores justice-involved individuals to their community through job skills training.
